email.subject: Quick note on Gentle Works Dentistry's site
email.body:
Hi Ravi,

I checked Gentle Works Dentistry's website and found a couple of issues likely costing you new patients. The site isn't mobile-friendly, and most dental searches happen on phones, so visitors are probably leaving before they even see your services. On top of that, there's no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors have to manually dial instead of tapping to call.

I fix issues like these for a flat fee, no retainer. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what's losing you patients?

Alex
Northlight Web
